# Diffmap repository guidance

Semvariant stores repository guidance as scoped rules. This file indexes their titles; full rules contain the rationale, exceptions, and examples.
Rules apply here and in descendant directories, together with rules in ancestor AGENTS.md files.
Before editing or reviewing, run `npm run semvariant -- context <paths>` from the repository root. Add `--full` or use `npm run semvariant -- show <IDs>` to read the complete guidance before applying it.
Edit the owning rule files, then run `npm run semvariant -- generate` and `npm run semvariant -- check`. This file is generated; do not edit it by hand.
